title: Uruguayan Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew inspired by Uruguayan cuisine, with tender beef and navy beans in a rich broth.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Add the onions and potatoes to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the navy beans, bean stew, and browned beef back to the pot. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 hour.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
